sources.title: andreasmartin/apertus-v1.5-8b-text · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A text-only derivative of swiss-ai/Apertus-v1.5-8B (Swiss AI Initiative: ETH Zurich / EPFL / CSCS), repackaged as a standard, lightweight apertus checkpoint (ApertusForCausalLM). The checkpoint loads with release transformers >= 4.56 — no fork, no trust_remote_code — and is compatible with Unsloth, vLLM, llama.cpp/GGUF, MLX, and LM Studio.

sources.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure
sources.snippet: This allows researchers, public institutions and companies to inspect, adapt and improve the model for their own needs. A long-term vision for sovereign AI The release of Apertus 1.5 marks another step towards a long-term goal: building a sovereign AI infrastructure that provides an open alternative to proprietary commercial models.
